mia.name: Mia Kowalski
mia.bio: Covers the Australian wagering industry: regulation, operator news and how rule changes reach punters. Eight years on the betting and racing beat.

tom.name: Tom Reyes
tom.bio: Writes the plain-English guides: odds, multis, limits and BetStop. Former trading-desk analyst who now explains the maths without the jargon.

partner-desk.name: Partner Desk
partner-desk.bio: Prepares partner articles with betting brands. Every piece is labelled as paid, checked for responsible-gambling messaging and kept apart from the newsroom.
